| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|

| **Description** | A brief description of the idea |
| **Date Added** | When the idea was added |
| **Status** | Current status (e.g., New, In Review, Approved, Rejected) |
| **Owner** | Person responsible for following up |
| **Notes** | Additional notes or comments |

---

1. Add a new row for each fresh idea.
2. Update the status as the idea progresses.
3. Attach any relevant documents or links in the Notes section.

---

{"file_content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Idea Title** | A concise title for the idea |
| **Description** | A brief description of the idea |
| **Date Added** | When the idea was added |
| **Status** | Current status(e.g., New, In Review, Approved, Rejected) |
| **Owner** | Person responsible for following up |
| **Notes** | Additional notes or comments |

---

## How to Use

1. Add a new row for each fresh idea.
2. Update the status as the idea progresses.
